title: Barca sunset tour
text: Truly amazing. David our skipper was super knowledgeable about Barcelona and made the trip spectacular. Far exceeded any expectations.
author: Kimberly_P

title: very nice sailing tour
text: a very nice sailing tour with super nice crew and good catering on a comfortable sailboat. unfortunately we were not suitably dressed, luckily the captain could help out with warming blankets and jackets. highly recommended sailing trip.
author: arminh936

title: Gorgeous sunset boat service
text: Boat trip accommodated by lovely couple. Very hospitable and went above and beyond to make sure we are happy, we had drinks and meze to share and the sunset was beautiful. Highly recommend.
author: yasmini880

title: Sailboat skyfill
text: We did a sunset greeting by sailboat along the coast of Barcelona. I loved watching Barcelona from the sea and setting the sun. Later we could see the whole coastline illuminated. Captain, Christian, a good professional and very friendly. A very nice experience. I recommend it
author: Q9075RDanac

title: Sunset on sailboat
text:
Watching the sunset in Barcelona from the sea is another way to visualize this city.
Cristian (the captain) is an excellent professional and very friendly.

Very good experience that I recommend to all people.
Five stars for this activity
author: 922jordit

title: Unforgettable experience
text:

Not only were we able to enjoy an incredible sunset, but we were also able to take a refreshing swim. 
We will certainly repeat

title: Magical Sunset Sail with Barcelona Sailing Point and Captain Christian!
text:
Magical Sunset Sail with Captain Christian!

We had an absolutely amazing evening sailing around Barcelona harbour with Captain Christian! From the moment we stepped on board, he made us feel welcome and at ease. The boat was spotless and comfortable, and the atmosphere was relaxed yet full of excitement.

Watching the sun set over the Barcelona skyline from the water was truly breathtaking, and the gentle breeze made it feel like the perfect summer night.

Everything was perfectly timed, and we never felt rushed—just a beautiful, unhurried experience with stunning views and great company. Thi
